verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 is a hardware platform, but it exposes programmatic interfaces such as Redfish and the CUDA runtime and driver APIs, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. The evidence shows only static documentation and llms.txt indexes. There is no interactive explorer or runnable examples, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
